title: Mashed RE — D3 active, D4 save path live

fields.label: Save path LIVE in the exe
fields.value: Save/GameSave.cpp builds into mashed_re.exe and its four functions are CALLED — SaveStatusClear / SaveLoad / SaveWrite / SaveFileExists. GameFlow routes save+load through them. 4/4 then 5/5 gates, (b) and (e) digit-identical

fields.label: Live bug fixed
fields.value: gamesave_parse.py PROFILE_SIZE was 0x2443C, should be 0x24A3C — the profile/tail boundary sat 0x600 too low. 16/16 tests

fields.label: exe/asi gap
fields.value: 619 of 888 verified (C3/C4) functions build ONLY into the dev .asi, which never ships

fields.label: But do NOT bulk-link
fields.value: RH_ScopedInstall is a no-op in the exe, so a linked body is a dead export unless called by name. The lever is CALL SITES — 0x00469df0 sits in the exe with zero callers

fields.label: U-9194
fields.value: RETRACTED same day. The port's omega arm is CORRECT — +0x10 == 0 on 222 of 222 moving frames; the 70.60% figure counted 2558 frames of a parked, eliminated car

fields.label: U-9191
fields.value: Still OPEN. The position join's median induced heading error is 0.087865 deg, so any gate on it needs a threshold above ~0.88 deg

fields.label: Save acceptance
fields.value: UNANSWERED after 8 measured steps. Bounded to one unknown: the 0x00409b0e jumptable and its caller. The save flow is a six-variable state cluster

fields.label: Pick one
value: Give an already-ported body a call site (0x00469df0 is the worked example)

fields.label: Lesson
fields.value: Four confident claims needed retracting; every one was caught by a second instrument or a control, never by re-reading. Write the control that can fail
